observations: No24 visible on porch pillar, middle-right house immediately left of25. Five storeys with short upper tier, three sash bays, pale stucco, rusticated ground floor, Ionic porch at right-hand bay, first-floor column/pilaster order with central triangular pediment and continuous stone balustrade.

Top cornice over24 is smoother/simpler than ornate dentils on25; upper middle storey windows have thin vertical Juliet bars. Red van obscures doorway bottom and street. Roof planes hidden. North facade image does not establish original south-source doorway or rear openings.
